error[ZBX-E0515]: a layer entry would leave the image's root
  while  unpacking layer 1 of 1
  cause  layer 1 has '/etc/passwd', an absolute path
  entry  /etc/passwd
  layer  1
  fix    do not run this image unless you built it, and check what it writes
         the downloaded blobs are kept, so the layers are not fetched again
  more   zbx explain E0515
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0515.html
